offering_description.value: Supplies well construction, completion, drilling, evaluation and production equipment and services to oil and gas operators. It manufactures downhole tools and artificial lift equipment, deploys field crews to install and operate equipment at wells, and provides software to monitor and optimize production.

primary_products.value: well construction and completion tools; drilling and formation evaluation tools; artificial lift equipment; well intervention tools; production monitoring and optimization software

primary_services.value: tubular running; directional and managed pressure drilling; formation evaluation; artificial lift installation and servicing; well intervention

customer_segment.value: B2B: Major and independent oil and gas producers and state-owned oil companies

end_markets.value: onshore oil and gas exploration and production; offshore oil and gas exploration and production

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Field crews, equipment and technical work for well construction, drilling, completions and production operations; product sales: Downhole tools, completion systems, artificial lift equipment and replacement parts; rental or leasing: Temporary use of downhole tools and other oilfield equipment; licensing or royalties: Software for monitoring and optimizing oil and gas production
revenue_model.category: project or contract; product sales; rental or leasing; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Deploys crews and specialized tools to construct, evaluate and service wells for oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: Builds downhole tools, completion systems and artificial lift equipment from components for oil and gas operators; software / platform: Processes well and equipment data for oil and gas operators to monitor and optimize production
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Well construction and completions, drilling and evaluation, production and intervention, and oilfield software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial teams contract with oil and gas operators, with delivery through local field service teams

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Field operations and tools are subject to workplace safety, environmental, well-control and radiation safety rules.

notes: The current relative scale of the operating lines is uncertain.
